units.source_excerpt: Currently, coaches, players, and managers are all aware that momentum plays a huge role in the progress of tennis matches. By analyzing the changes in momentum during the game, we can evaluate the performance of players during specific time periods and make speculations about the game results.
units.function: open on a shared awareness
units.reusable_pattern: name the three readers and the thing they already know, then the two uses of analyzing it
prohibited_generalizations: Open by defining the quantity the reader already knows.

units.source_excerpt: By understanding the factors that influence the momentum of the game, we can assess the fluctuations in the game process and construct a player training system. Therefore, it is crucial to recognize the role of momentum in the game and use it to help players cope with events that affect the progress of the game.
units.function: turn understanding into a duty
units.reusable_pattern: give the two things understanding buys, then the duty that follows
prohibited_generalizations: Stop at the understanding.

units.source_excerpt: Firstly, we established an Instantaneous Score Rate model to capture match points. After using the cubic spline interpolation method to process discrete data, the model can smoothly estimate the instantaneous score rate at any time and accurately capture key moments. The results clearly demonstrate the first mover advantage of the serving party, which is consistent with the facts.
units.function: report a model and its agreement with fact
units.reusable_pattern: name the model and its purpose, the method, the two capabilities, then the agreement
reusable_elements: can smoothly estimate, and accurately capture
which is consistent with the facts
prohibited_generalizations: Claim the advantage without saying it matches the facts.

units.source_excerpt: Then, we establish a model to test the role of momentum. The results indicate that there is not independent between fluctuations in the game and the success of players. In addition to the first mover advantage, there will be a strong momentum that affects the instantaneous score rate.
units.function: report a rejection in the paper's grammar
units.reusable_pattern: state the test, give the result in the paper's own wording, then the conclusion
prohibited_generalizations: Repair the grammar of the result.

units.source_excerpt: Next, in order to predict fluctuations, we use a gated recurrent network with integrated gradients for feature disentanglement engineering. Based on the model, we can fit the momentum function under existing conditions to accurately predict the change. We manually divided the original indicators into six dimensions.
units.function: name the tool and the hand division
units.reusable_pattern: give the purpose, the tool, what it fits, then the manual step
prohibited_generalizations: Hide the fact that the dimensions were chosen by hand.

units.source_excerpt: Based on the model results, we have identified 12 important indicators that have an significant impact on schedule fluctuations. On this basis, we established a competency evaluation system based on six dimensions, and provided targeted suggestions to players based on the analysis of real player abilities.
units.function: count the indicators and build the system
units.reusable_pattern: give the count, then the system, then the advice
prohibited_generalizations: Correct the article before significant.

units.source_excerpt: In addition, we tested the predictive ability of the model in real-time data of different genders, game systems, and ball games. The test results have shown that our model can accurately predict other competition processes and has high generalization ability.
units.function: claim generalization across three changes
units.reusable_pattern: name the three kinds of change, then the claim
prohibited_generalizations: Claim generalization from one kind of change.

units.source_excerpt: Finally, in order to help coaches cultivate players to better cope with events that affect the tennis schedule, we provide targeted recommendations. We hope these suggestions can help players achieve victory in the new game.
units.function: close on the coaches and a hope
units.reusable_pattern: name the beneficiary and the purpose, then hope for victory
reusable_elements: We hope these suggestions can help
prohibited_generalizations: Close on the model's accuracy.

units.source_excerpt: Djokovic seemed destined for an easy win, winning the first set by an absolute margin of 5 points; the second set was tense, with Alcaraz winning 7-6 in a tie-break; and the third set was the opposite of the first. After a number of changes in the trend, Djokovic lost at Wimbledon for the first time since 2013.
units.function: narrate the upset in three sets
units.reusable_pattern: give each set its character, then the historical consequence
reusable_elements: was the opposite of the first
prohibited_generalizations: Summarize the match as one result.

units.source_excerpt: In tennis, momentum means the power that a player acquires in a match through movement or a series of events. When momentum can be used to measure a player's performance at a particular point, the players, coaches, and managers have an advantage in determining how the situation is changing.
units.function: define the quantity by its use
units.reusable_pattern: define the word, then say what the measurement gives the reader
prohibited_generalizations: Define the word and stop.

units.source_excerpt: As a result, coaches would like to better understand if momentum can be used to determine player performance and the extent to which it can be used. If possible, coaches would like to gain a better understanding of the factors that influence the fluctuations, so that they can better judge the future course of the game.
units.function: state the coach's two wishes
units.reusable_pattern: give the first wish, then the conditional second wish and its purpose
reusable_elements: As a result, coaches would like to
prohibited_generalizations: Merge the two wishes into one.

units.source_excerpt: Academics have paid attention to the issue of momentum in sports events. Some scholars have looked at the psychology of athletes, the point of serve, strategic momentum, and other aspects of momentum in mental tennis.
units.function: list the aspects already studied
units.reusable_pattern: say the topic has attention, then list the aspects
prohibited_generalizations: Correct the printed phrase mental tennis.

units.source_excerpt: Existing empirical research suggests that players can control the match to benefit themselves from momentum, and that the amount of countermovement will result in a significantly lower chance of winning the underdog set. Generalized linear mixed-effects models have also been constructed to demonstrate the legacy effects of score, game, and set.
units.function: give the literature its findings
units.reusable_pattern: report two findings and the model that produced the third
reusable_elements: have also been constructed to demonstrate
prohibited_generalizations: Cite the method without its finding.

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, by analyzing a large amount of game flow data, we can explore the relationship between momentum and its scoring rate, and visualize the game flow from the perspective of momentum, with a view to providing references for coaches, players, the public and the media.
units.function: name four audiences
units.reusable_pattern: give the method, the two products, and the four readers
reusable_elements: with a view to providing references for
prohibited_generalizations: Write for the coach alone.

units.source_excerpt: Some scholars have pointed out that the factors that cause changes in momentum are multiple, including errors and psychological changes. Some empirical scholars have focused on the break point as an important variable. On this basis, by examining the mechanisms, we can analyze which factors have the greatest impact and suggest that the four audiences pay attention to these indicators.
units.function: move from many factors to the greatest
units.reusable_pattern: grant the multiplicity, name the one indicator already studied, then promise the ranking
prohibited_generalizations: Treat all factors as equal.

units.source_excerpt: A preliminary finding is that there is little difference in the ability of male and female players to overcome the influence of momentum. Gender, venue, and type of match may affect the results, which leads us to test the generalizability of the model to changing contexts.
units.function: let one finding force a test
units.reusable_pattern: give the finding, name the three things that may change it, then the test
prohibited_generalizations: Assert generalizability without the threat.

units.source_excerpt: Build model 1 to capture match points in the flow of the game and identify the players who performed better and to what extent at a given point. Provide a visualization of the flow. Judge whether the fluctuation of momentum is independent of the subsequent scoring.
units.function: restate the first model as three jobs
units.reusable_pattern: give the model its capture, its identification, and its test
prohibited_generalizations: Restate the model as one job.

units.source_excerpt: Build model 2 to predict fluctuations in momentum and identify better metrics. Test the accuracy and generalizability. Give tactical strategies for winning against different opponents based on the fluctuations.
units.function: restate the second model as prediction and advice
units.reusable_pattern: give the prediction, the test, and the strategies
prohibited_generalizations: Give the strategies with no basis in the fluctuations.

units.source_excerpt: A memo written by summarizes the results and advises coaches on influencing the direction of play through the momentum, and on preparing players for events that affect the tennis schedule.

units.reusable_pattern: name the memo and its two directions, and keep the printed grammar
prohibited_generalizations: Repair the subjectless phrase.

units.source_excerpt: We examined the extent to which momentum reflects player performance, and based on its impact indicators, we provide coaches with suggestions for focusing on the role of momentum and developing good players.

units.reusable_pattern: state the question as an extent, then the advice it produces
prohibited_generalizations: Promise advice before the extent is examined.

units.source_excerpt: Not considering the decline in performance of players due to injury or physical factors.

units.reusable_pattern: exclude injury and physical decline in one line
prohibited_generalizations: Add a reason the paper does not give.

units.source_excerpt: There is no negative game phenomenon such as players maliciously controlling points.

units.reusable_pattern: exclude the case where a player controls the points on purpose
reusable_elements: no negative game phenomenon such as
prohibited_generalizations: Soften the exclusion.

units.source_excerpt: The competition is formal, and the vast majority of off field factors have been screened out. The only off field factor that can affect the game situation is the current score of the match.

units.reusable_pattern: say the factors were screened, then name the single one that remains
reusable_elements: the vast majority, have been screened out
prohibited_generalizations: Leave more than one factor standing.

units.source_excerpt: Assuming previous research data is accurate.

units.reusable_pattern: state the trust in one line
prohibited_generalizations: Qualify the trust the paper states flatly.

units.source_excerpt: Other symbols will be introduced once they are used. The table holds the point number, the time, the relative point, the relative score curve, the instantaneous score rate, and the momentum curve.

units.reusable_pattern: promise to define symbols at the point of use, then list the ones present

prohibited_generalizations: Treat all the data as given.

units.source_excerpt: The dataset encompasses detailed point-by-point data from Grand Slam matches. It provides exhaustive details for each point, including serve details, scoring, and errors. Additionally, we manually collected the table tennis final of the 2020 Olympics as our supplementary dataset.

units.reusable_pattern: describe the main set, then the supplementary one and its sport

units.source_excerpt: The data were divided into 32 time series according to the matches. For the missing values, we filled them according to the distribution they belonged to.

units.reusable_pattern: split by match, then announce the rule for the gaps
reusable_elements: according to the distribution they belonged to
prohibited_generalizations: Fill every gap the same way.

units.source_excerpt: Serve speed was sampled from a normal distribution of the player's habits in other matches. Two-valued variables were filled from a Bernoulli distribution of that player's frequencies. Many-valued variables used a multinomial distribution. Distance run used a uniform distribution. The outlier zero in the tension was resampled from a distribution built on the other games.

reusable_elements: resampled it according to that distribution
prohibited_generalizations: Use one distribution for every column.

units.source_excerpt: At the end of a match, we can not only get the result, but often also a lot of information about the process: whether the first server has an advantage, which player performs better early, which performs better late, and to what extent.

units.reusable_pattern: contrast the result with the process, then list the questions
prohibited_generalizations: Stop at the result of the match.

units.source_excerpt: Due to the discrete characteristics of the data, in order to analyze the whole process and to predict the trend, we use cubic spline interpolation to turn the discrete points into a twice differentiable function, in order to derive the instantaneous scoring ratio at each point.

prohibited_generalizations: Interpolate without saying what the derivative is for.

units.source_excerpt: Cubic spline interpolation ensures smooth continuity through each point, and continuity of the first and second derivatives, avoiding the oscillations common to higher-order polynomial interpolation, the Runge phenomenon. Its ability to control locally means that adjusting a point affects only a small part of the curve, not the whole.
units.function: defend the spline by what it avoids
units.reusable_pattern: name the two continuities, the phenomenon avoided, and the local control
reusable_elements: not only ensures, but also ensures
affect only a small part, not the whole
prohibited_generalizations: Choose the method without saying what it avoids.

units.source_excerpt: We write the sample points in order, define the spacing, and select natural boundary conditions. It can be proved that the segmented function is everywhere twice differentiable.

units.reusable_pattern: give the ordering, the boundary choice, and the property that follows
prohibited_generalizations: Assert the property without the conditions.

units.source_excerpt: After obtaining the relative scoring curve, we can use the derivative to describe the instantaneous change in scoring, that is, the current direction of the match. It can be used to describe the match flow very well.

units.reusable_pattern: name the derivative, gloss it as direction, then claim the description
reusable_elements: we can use the derivative to describe
prohibited_generalizations: Plot the derivative without saying what it means.

units.source_excerpt: By analyzing the position of the instantaneous scoring rate relative to zero, we can assess the scoring efficiency of each player. When it is below zero, the player's scoring will be reduced. The further the distance from zero, the higher or lower the scoring rate.

units.reusable_pattern: give the sign its meaning, then the distance its meaning
reusable_elements: The further the distance, the higher or lower
prohibited_generalizations: Report the value without the reading rule.

units.source_excerpt: Based on the above analysis, it is easy to find that the relative scoring rate of a player is usually higher when that player serves first. By studying the frequency graph, the one who serves first gets a higher winning rate, which is the first-hand advantage in the game.
units.function: name the advantage from the figure
units.reusable_pattern: read the figure, confirm it with the second figure, then name the advantage
reusable_elements: it is easy to find that
prohibited_generalizations: Name the advantage before the figure.

units.source_excerpt: In order to investigate the role of momentum, we developed an independent model and a non-independent model, so as to better respond to the coaches' questions. The study shows that the independent model does not hold, and that the sequential hands and the momentum jointly affect the scoring rate.
units.function: announce the verdict before the test
units.reusable_pattern: give the purpose, the two models, then the result ahead of the proof
reusable_elements: The study shows that, does not hold
prohibited_generalizations: Save the verdict for the end.

units.source_excerpt: If the future scoring rate and the potential are independent, a change in the potential will not affect the future scoring rate. We first eliminate the part about the first-hand advantage, subtracting the expectation and dividing by the sample variance. The difference should be independent and follow the same bounded distribution.
units.function: derive what independence would look like
units.reusable_pattern: state the consequence, the removal, and the distribution that should follow
prohibited_generalizations: Test independence without saying what it predicts.

units.source_excerpt: From the central limit theorem, a sequence of independent variables with bounded expectation and variance, once normalized, converges to the standard normal distribution, with single-peak characteristics. However, the difference distribution has bimodal peaks and does not obey the normal distribution. Therefore, the prior and the potential are not independent, and the independence model does not hold.
units.function: reject a model by the shape of a histogram
units.reusable_pattern: state what the theorem requires, show the figure violates it, then reject
prohibited_generalizations: Reject the model on a test statistic the paper never computes.

units.source_excerpt: Since the independent model did not hold, we examined the non-independent model, that is, factors other than the forehand serve. The scoring rate coincides with the peak of the expected difference once the serve effect is removed. This indicates that at a certain period, no matter the serve, there is a stronger advantage, so the potential and the successive hands jointly affect the scoring rate, and the non-independence model is established.
units.function: let the failure choose the next model
units.reusable_pattern: name the failure, the reading, and the model it establishes
prohibited_generalizations: Adopt the second model without the first one's failure.

units.source_excerpt: In order to investigate when the flow shifts from favoring one player to favoring another, this study, based on the gated network and the integrated gradient, aims to get the prediction of the shift, so as to get the key factors and thus make suggestions for the new game.
units.function: chain four purposes
units.reusable_pattern: give the question, the tools, the prediction, the factors, and the advice in one chain
prohibited_generalizations: Break the chain into separate claims.

units.source_excerpt: The amplitude and frequency of this scoring rate are extremely large, which is very unfavorable for estimating this value effectively. Thus, we chose a ten-point moving average, each point equal to the average of the first ten scoring points.
units.function: justify the smoothing by the vibration
units.reusable_pattern: name the defect, then the remedy and its definition
reusable_elements: extremely large, which is very unfavorable
prohibited_generalizations: Smooth the curve without saying what was wrong with it.

units.source_excerpt: The moving average can effectively reflect the trend, so we choose it as the momentum of the match. When the average line crosses the zero axis, the momentum of the game has changed at this time.
units.function: define the change as a crossing
units.reusable_pattern: adopt the average as the momentum, then define the change
reusable_elements: can effectively reflect, so we choose
prohibited_generalizations: Define the change without the picture.

units.source_excerpt: We tried to fit the momentum function based on the known information through the network. The gated network is simpler than the long memory network, and the effect is also very good, so it is a current streaming kind of network, which can solve the long dependence problem. There are only two gates, the update gate and the reset gate.
units.function: choose the network for its simplicity
units.reusable_pattern: state the attempt, compare with the rival, then count the gates
reusable_elements: is simpler than, and the effect is also very good
prohibited_generalizations: Choose the network without the comparison.

units.source_excerpt: In a plain recurrent network, when the sequence is too long the gradient disappears, so the parameters capture only the local relationship and the memory of the early words is weak. The gated model uses fewer parameters to mitigate the vanishing.
units.function: give the disease and the mitigation
units.reusable_pattern: name the failure, its consequence, then the mitigation
reusable_elements: when the sequence is too long
prohibited_generalizations: Name the mitigation without the disease.

units.source_excerpt: To further model the match between the two players, we added a player embedding, generating a feature vector for each player. At moment t the initial feature is transformed through a multi-head mapping and merged with the embeddings of both players.
units.function: add the players to the input
units.reusable_pattern: state the purpose, the device, and the merge
prohibited_generalizations: Feed the network the point data alone.

units.source_excerpt: We have generated the momentum of the players at moment t, where the difference between them is the momentum predicted by the model at this moment. During training, we utilize the squared error loss to enable the model to learn how to predict the real momentum.
units.function: define the prediction as a difference

reusable_elements: where the difference between them is
to enable the model to learn how to
prohibited_generalizations: Report the loss without saying what it teaches.

units.source_excerpt: Due to the complexity of the original data, the many indicators, and the high cost of obtaining them, the input is complicated. To make the model have a practical prediction function under the existing conditions, we optimize the inputs, so as to invert the output back to the original inputs and get the key factors.

prohibited_generalizations: Reduce the input without the cost.

units.source_excerpt: The irrelevant information is eliminated. After removing the five dimensions such as the match identifier, which is not very relevant to the real-time score, 39 dimensions remain. These were categorized into six attributes: mentality, endurance, error rate, starting advantage, skill, and key moments.

prohibited_generalizations: Group the columns before removing the irrelevant ones.

units.source_excerpt: The mentality attribute covers the points and the sets, which have a complex impact on the mentality, for example the score may cause the trailing player's defense to collapse. The endurance covers the distance and the duration. When the serve number is 2, the player has already made a mistake, and the double faults and unforced errors are attributed to the error rate.
units.function: justify each group with an example
units.reusable_pattern: give each attribute its contents and one reason
prohibited_generalizations: Name a group with no example.

units.source_excerpt: The entire information in each attribute is aggregated into a single number through six linear layers. The number is fixed between minus one and one by a hyperbolic tangent, and used as the value of that attribute. The resulting six numbers are fed to the network.
units.function: compress each attribute to one number
units.reusable_pattern: give the aggregation, the bounding, and the use
prohibited_generalizations: Feed the raw columns to the network.

units.source_excerpt: The integrated gradient calculates the strength of the influence of the input features on the output. It combines the direct gradient with the backpropagation-based techniques, and satisfies the axioms of sensitivity and implementation invariance.

units.source_excerpt: There are positive and negative impact strengths, because the attributes affect the momentum in both directions, in which the miss rate plays a negative role and the rest are positive. In this study, only absolute values are considered, to reflect the magnitude of the influence.

units.source_excerpt: The backpropagation optimizes not only the network's own parameters but also the six linear layers. From this, we can consider the strength of the attribute and the proportion of each piece of information inside it, to select the information with the greatest impact.

units.source_excerpt: The coefficients are both positive and negative, and again we take the absolute value. We found twelve highly influential pieces of information, which are extremely easy to obtain and drastically reduce the cost of collection compared with the original 39 dimensions.

units.reusable_pattern: name the hand work, the method, the count, and the payoff
prohibited_generalizations: Claim the prediction without the manual step.

units.source_excerpt: We built a six-attribute evaluation system to make suggestions for players to deal with different opponents. On the basis of testing the generalizability, we provide training suggestions for coaches, pointing out the indicators and dimensions they can focus on, so as to improve the overall competitiveness of players on the court.
units.function: end on the coaches
units.reusable_pattern: name the system, the test, and the purpose of the suggestions
prohibited_generalizations: End on the model.

units.source_excerpt: We are able to predict the future direction of momentum with very little and easily accessible data at a very high level of refinement.
units.function: claim accuracy from cheap data
units.reusable_pattern: name the data's cheapness and the refinement together
reusable_elements: with very little and easily accessible data
at a very high level of refinement
prohibited_generalizations: Claim accuracy without the cost.

units.source_excerpt: We have a complete theory and algorithms for reproducing various attribute metrics of players. Our model has good generalization and can still maintain high prediction accuracy in other types of tennis matches and even in other ball games.
units.function: claim completeness and reach
units.reusable_pattern: claim the theory, then the reach across match types and sports
prohibited_generalizations: Claim generalization without the examples.

units.source_excerpt: If we have more data, we can further train the model to better evaluate each person's attribute values and improve the prediction accuracy by having more players compete with each other.
units.function: condition the improvement on data
units.reusable_pattern: give the condition and the two gains
reusable_elements: If we have more data, we can
prohibited_generalizations: Promise the improvement unconditionally.

units.source_excerpt: We are unable to obtain information through statistical data from past competitions, such as weather conditions, venue information, player tactical adjustments, and their adaptability.
units.function: list what the data cannot carry
units.reusable_pattern: state the inability and list the examples
prohibited_generalizations: Imply the data could be extended to these.

units.source_excerpt: Nine references, one of them a newspaper article on the final, one a book titled Momentum: The Hidden Force in Tennis, and one paper repeated under two numbers.
units.function: list the sources and keep the duplicate
units.reusable_pattern: note the range and keep the repeated entry
prohibited_generalizations: Remove the duplicate entry.

units.source_excerpt: From the team, to the coaches, dated the fifth of February 2024. Dear Sir and Madam.
units.function: give the memo its header
units.reusable_pattern: give the sender, the recipient, and the date
prohibited_generalizations: Start the memo without the header.

units.source_excerpt: In response to your request, we have developed two models. The scoring rate model identifies which player is performing better at a given point and verifies the first-hand advantage. Before using the network, we tested whether momentum has an impact, and the results were that it had a significant effect.
units.function: answer the request in order
units.reusable_pattern: name the request, the two models, and the test that came between them
prohibited_generalizations: Present the models without the request.

units.source_excerpt: Since the twelve indicators affect the momentum, and the momentum affects the score, and then the result, in order to make the players perform better in the next game, we put forward the following suggestions.
units.function: chain the indicators to the result
units.reusable_pattern: give the three-link chain and then the suggestions
reusable_elements: we put forward the following suggestions
prohibited_generalizations: Give the suggestions with no chain.

units.source_excerpt: First of all, momentum has a significant impact on the change of the game process. It is a quantitative expression of the fluctuation, and coaches can monitor the performance in a more concrete and intuitive way in real time. This is the role of momentum.
units.function: define the role at the end
units.reusable_pattern: state the impact, the definition, the use, then name it the role
prohibited_generalizations: Define the role before the use.

units.source_excerpt: Secondly, the pre-match analysis starts from the opponent's six attributes and targets the weak ones. For example, if the mentality is poor, increase the score early to put on psychological pressure, or play steadily and overtake once the opponent is slightly ahead, so that the opponent loses self-confidence.
units.function: give one example with two options
units.reusable_pattern: state the rule, then one example with two ways
prohibited_generalizations: Give the rule with no example.

units.source_excerpt: Again, the post-game summary starts from the changes in momentum and uses the twelve indicators to determine the reasons, so as to avoid the advantage flowing to the opponent and to get ready for the next game.
units.function: turn the summary into preparation
units.reusable_pattern: give the source, the use, and the two purposes
prohibited_generalizations: Treat the summary as an end.

units.source_excerpt: In terms of tactics, attention should be paid to the direction, depth, and speed of the serve, so as to increase the player's own momentum. The player can hit to the two sides of the court, to increase the opponent's distance and consume his physical strength, which will make him reveal his weaknesses.
units.function: give the tactic and its mechanism
units.reusable_pattern: name the target, the purpose, and the chain of effects
prohibited_generalizations: Give the tactic without the mechanism.

units.source_excerpt: When a player has a double fault or an unforced error, he should adjust his mindset positively. The sets, games, and points are also the key to influence the mindset.
units.function: tie the error to the mindset
units.reusable_pattern: give the event, the response, and the wider rule
prohibited_generalizations: Leave the error as a number.

units.source_excerpt: As shown in the figure, we have proposed targeted suggestions based on the three most influential dimensions and their core indicators. We hope our suggestions are helpful. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us. Thank you for reading.
units.function: close with an offer of contact
units.reusable_pattern: point at the figure, hope, offer contact, and thank
reusable_elements: We hope our suggestions are helpful
prohibited_generalizations: Close without the offer.

units.source_excerpt: The appendix prints the network: six linear layers, one per attribute, each without bias and each passed through a hyperbolic tangent, then a gated network with a player embedding of 32 players and a dropout of 0.2.
units.function: let the code carry the numbers
units.reusable_pattern: report the structure the prose never numbers
prohibited_generalizations: Restate the code in prose and drop the numbers.
